items.title: Claude Fable 5 plays Pokémon FireRed using only screenshots
items.summary: Claude Fable 5 finished Pokémon FireRed by looking at the game screen alone, with no extra game data.
items.what: Claude Fable 5 finished Pokémon FireRed by looking at the game screen alone.
items.setup: It got only raw screenshots and a minimal harness, with no game-state help. Earlier models struggled even with helper harnesses.
items.result: It completed the game with vision alone, a clear step up from earlier Claude models.
